title.narrative: Supporting NDCs Stocktaking and NDCs Revision Roadmap for Sudan

description.narrative: Sudan submitted its revised Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) in 2022, reaffirming its commitment to the Paris Agreement and to a transition toward low-carbon, climate-resilient development aligned with its long-term national vision. The 2022 NDC built upon the Third National Communication, Biennial Update Report, and national REDD+ processes, ensuring a balanced focus on mitigation and adaptation. Priority mitigation sectors included energy, forestry, and waste, while adaptation efforts focused on water resources, agriculture, public health, and coastal zones, with implementation planned through 2030. The NDC estimated financing needs of USD 4.393 billion for mitigation and USD 3.850 billion for adaptation.Widespread destruction of energy infrastructure, mass displacement, deterioration of essential services, degradation of natural resources, and increased environmental pollution have altered both the country’s emissions profile and its climate vulnerability landscape.
